articles.summary: Barrons.com: Bond Market Signals Go-Ahead For Bank Stocks with JP Morgan Earnings On Deck. A steeper yield curve and strong deal activity are lifting bank stocks ahead of JPMorgan’s earnings, with analysts expecting financials to drive a fifth of S&P 500 profits. articles.title: Wells Fargo Recruits $1.2 Billion Advisory Team From Citigroup
articles.mainIdea: Wells Fargo Recruits $1.2 Billion Advisory Team From Citigroup
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Wells Fargo Recruits $1.2 Billion Advisory Team From Citigroup. Wells Fargo has recruited an advisory duo in Texas managing $1.2 billion in client assets. Paul Cooke and Jake Trousdale have joined Wells Fargo’s Private Client Group in Dallas. The move comes amid a reorganization within Citigroup that will see a new CFO take over in March and the firm’s retail banking operations be consolidated and organized within the wealth business, headed by Andy Sieg. Related tickers mentioned: WFC.
